display.purpose: The group name, hand-lettered directly on the board — the only 40px PermanentMarker text in the product.

page-title.purpose: A page's own on-board headline when it isn't a group name — the NFL/CFB picks pages. Chalk-white, sits directly on the board like the hero.

title.purpose: Section headers on every paper card, always PermanentMarker in marker-red.

label.purpose: Eyebrows, column headers, badges, timestamps — system sans, never marker.

body.purpose: Default UI text — names, picks, chat, CTA subtext.

shadows.name: card-lift
shadows.purpose: Standings and Power Rankings — the two surfaces worth the most craft on the page.

shadows.name: cta-lift
shadows.purpose: The two hero NFL/CFB pick CTA buttons — the strongest shadow on the page.

shadows.name: auth-lift

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Pill-shaped primary action (Refresh scores, Share invite) — Turf Teal survives from the prior world unchanged, deliberately not re-skinned in marker-red.

components.name: Paper Card
components.description: The standard chalk-paper sheet used for every section — dashed border, tape-corner accent, PermanentMarker title in marker-red. Square, not tilted (see The Accent-Only Tilt Rule): only the tape carries rotation.
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; background: #F5F3E7; border: 1.5px dashed rgba(12,23,18,0.18); border-radius: 10px; padding: 12px; padding-top: 16px; } .ds-tape { position: absolute; top: -8px; left: 16px; width: 46px; height: 18px; background: rgba(244,196,48,0.55); border: 1px solid rgba(180,140,20,0.35); transform: rotate(-3deg); } .ds-card-title { font-family: 'Permanent Marker', cursive; font-size: 20px; color: #B23A2E; }

components.name: Rank Circle (First Place)
components.description: The #1 spot in Power Rankings — a marker-red circle outline, transparent fill, straight (not tilted — an earlier -4deg version read as crooked per user feedback). Replaced a filled dark pill from the prior world; the product's 'coach circled your name on the board' signature moment.
components.css: .ds-rank-first { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #B23A2E; border: 2px solid #B23A2E; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; padding: 2px 8px; }

components.name: Rank Badge (Other)
components.description: Any rank below #1 in Power Rankings — a plain dark filled pill, unchanged from the prior world.
components.css: .ds-rank-badge { background: #0C1712; color: #FFFFFF; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 800; border-radius: 999px; padding: 1px 6px; }

narrative.overview: WeekendLocks is a locker-room whiteboard, not a dashboard. This replaces the product's prior visual world (Turf Teal + slate + white cards) entirely. A dark chalkboard-green board (#063D31) fills the screen and is the header itself — the group name is hand-lettered directly onto it in large chalk-white PermanentMarker type beside a drawn padlock icon. Every section below reads as a sheet of paper taped to that board: chalk-paper fill, dashed hand-drawn outline, and a masking-tape corner accent. Cards and every UI badge stay square — tilt lives only in physical-prop accents (tape, scattered home-page logo badges), never on anything a user reads as a control. The tone stays loud and personal, but the loudness now comes from material — chalk, marker, tape, paper — instead of a generic dark-mode sports-app template. Fully rolled out across the whole product: group dashboard, NFL/CFB picks pages, groups list/join, account, auth, and the home/marketing page.
keyCharacteristics: One board for every group: per-group hash-colored hero backgrounds were removed; identity now lives in the hand-lettered name and member avatar chips only.
Paper-pinned-to-board is the universal card language — dashed border and a shared TapeCorner component, never hand-rolled per file. Cards are square; see The Accent-Only Tilt Rule.
PermanentMarker is reserved for exactly two roles: the group name and section titles — never buttons, data, or body text.
No emoji anywhere in the product — every former emoji (lock, trophy, flame) is now an authored SVG icon sharing one stroke grammar.
The #1 spot in Power Rankings is circled in marker (transparent, red ring), straight, instead of a filled badge.

No avatar chip anywhere a name is already shown in the same row — Standings, Power Rankings, Recent Activity, and Chat all dropped theirs. Member identity color survives only in the Weekly Locks grid header, where the colored background is the name cell.
Only Standings and Power Rankings carry real shadow lift; Recent Activity and Chat stay flat.

rules.name: The Same Hash, Different Canvas Rule (narrowed)
rules.body: The six identity color pairs still power member avatars where a chip is shown, but no longer extend to group hero backgrounds — every group now shares one board. Never hand-pick an identity color or add a seventh.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: PermanentMarker is reserved for exactly two roles — the group name and section titles. It never appears on a button, a data value, or body copy.

rules.name: The Dashed Border Rule
rules.body: Every paper card uses a dashed border instead of a solid hairline, so the board reads as hand-assembled.

rules.name: The Accent-Only Tilt Rule
rules.body: Cards and any element read as UI (badges, circles, controls) are always square. An earlier pass tilted whole cards, then the Power Rankings #1 circle; both were flagged by direct user feedback as looking broken, not charming. Tilt survives only on physical-prop accents: TapeCorner, and the home page's scattered logo/icon chips.

rules.name: The List Restraint Rule
rules.body: The TapeCorner accent is for single-instance surfaces only, never for items inside a repeated list. The picks pages' game cards and the groups list's rows keep chalk-paper fill and dashed border but carry no tape.

rules.name: The Two-Tier Lift Rule
rules.body: Not every paper sheet gets the same shadow. Only Standings, Power Rankings, and the two hero CTAs earn real shadow lift; everything else stays flat.

dos: Do route every card through the shared card/cardElevated style plus a TapeCorner — never hand-roll a dashed border or tape rectangle inline.
Do keep PermanentMarker confined to the group name and section titles.
Do draw a new authored SVG icon matching LockIcon/TrophyIcon/FlameIcon's stroke grammar for any new section — never use an emoji.
Do give a card real shadow only when it's a genuinely high-value surface.
donts: Don't reintroduce per-group hash-colored hero backgrounds.
Don't use opacity to indicate a disabled state on a chalk-paper surface — it blends into the board behind it.
Don't add a seventh member-identity color or reorder the existing six.
Don't apply the paper-card language to the Danger Zone — it stays a plain red alert box.
Don't rotate a card, badge, or anything read as UI — tilt only belongs on physical-prop accents.
Don't use an emoji character anywhere in this product.
Don't add a member avatar chip next to a name already shown in the same row — it's redundant identity.
